label: Parallel run length
subgoals: Take the larger of the left ends
Take the smaller of the right ends
Subtract and clamp at zero to get the run length

label: Overlap between layers
subgoals: Find the pairs of crossing shapes on the two layers
Sum the areas for the layer pair

label: Neighbours within a coupling window
subgoals: Grow the victim by the coupling window
Keep neighbours whose gap is within the window
Sum their parallel run lengths with the victim
